List shows the agents recorded on this host as a nested list, with each
agent's status, backend, parent, session, and creation time. --host lists
another host's agents through the bus.

Status is the same live status "agent status" shows (idle, processing,
waiting, error, ended, unknown); "agent status <name> -v" says more, and
"agent statuses" what each means. A host running an older agent sends none,
shown as "-".

Each agent's helpers (spawned with "agent spawn") are nested right under it,
so a team reads as one tree. An agent can clean up only its own helpers and
theirs (another agent only once a person says to: agent help cleanup).

Usage:
  agent list [flags]

Examples:
  agent list
  agent list --host hub
  agent list --json

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for list
      --host string   Host whose agents to list (default: this host)
      --json          Print the agents as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
